subject: Shortburst rollover credits and threshold anchoring
messages:
From: Claire Huang <claire@luminahealth.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Cc: ops@luminahealth.com
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 16:15:00 -0700
Subject: Short-term burst request for product launch (May 27 – Jun 3)

Hi Rafael,

We have a hard launch scheduled for May 27 and expect a concentrated spike in inference traffic for 7 days. Can Redwood provision a short-term QPS/top-up for that window? Two asks: 1) an auto-topup option (so we don't hit a hard throttle) with clear provisional billing, and 2) whether any unused burst credits from this window can be rolled into June (we usually see spikes followed by quiet weeks).

Also, if Lumina commits to a 3-month elevated headroom (starting next billing cycle) would Redwood consider a discount on the transient overage rate? Budget needs to be pre-approved by procurement quickly — if you can send a term sheet and a PO-ready description that would help.

Summary of requirements: 
- Temp uplift: +2.5x baseline QPS for 7 days (May 27–Jun 3)
- Auto-topup threshold: 80% of uplifted quota, with immediate topup action
- Rollover request: up to 50% of unused burst credits to next month
- Discount ask: for a 3-month staged commit, discount on overrun units

Can you confirm feasibility and send an estimate/term sheet?

Thanks,
Claire Huang
Head of Engineering | LuminaHealth
claire@luminahealth.com
(415) 555-0128

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>

Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 09:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Short-term burst request for product launch (May 27 – Jun 3)

Hi Claire — thanks for the heads-up and congrats on the launch. We can support a temporary uplift with an auto-topup flow. I'm attaching a short term-sheet that outlines two options (prepaid top-up vs on-demand auto-topup with provisional billing).

Key summary (provisional):
- Proposed uplift: 2.5x baseline QPS for 7 days (May 27–Jun 3)
- Auto-topup trigger: 80% of current uplifted capacity; topup unit is measured in token-units and billed immediately at the overrun rate
- Discount proposal: 20% discount on overrun unit price for committed 3-month elevated headroom (applies to additional tokens consumed beyond baseline during the commit window)
- Rollover: we can provisionally allow up to 50% of unused paid burst credits to roll into the next calendar month (policy requires finance approval)

Attachments: lumina_temp_topup_term_sheet.pdf (pdf) — includes PO language.

Two quick asks so I can finalize the term: 
1) Confirm the baseline QPS (your telemetry indicates ~1.2k QPS — is that still correct?).
2) Do you want a prepaid credit for the 7-day window or an on-demand auto-topup? Prepaid secures capacity and simplifies rollover.

I'll loop in Laura from Finance for the rollover and discount approval. If we get your confirmation on baseline and topup mode today we can schedule the uplift.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
rafael@redwood.com

- Rollover: allow up to 50% of unused paid burst credits to be carried to June
- Discount: 20% off overrun units if they commit to a 3-month elevated headroom starting next billing cycle

Pricing note: baseline QPS is ~1.2k for Lumina per our telemetry. If we grant a 20% discount and allow 50% rollover, we should arc the cost over two months to avoid a big one-off revenue hit. Suggested mechanics:
- Offer the 7-day topup as an on-demand auto-topup (bill as consumed), but provide Lumina an option to prepay the uplift at a small premium.
- Approve 20% temporary discount for a 3-month staged commit; finance to amortize rollover credit over the first two post-spike invoices.

Can we get sign-off for the rollover + discount so I can send final terms?

Thanks,
Rafael

Rafael / Karthik — I read the ask and the attached term sheet. Finance is comfortable with a controlled rollover and the proposed 20% discount for a 3-month commit, with two conditions: 

1) Rollover cap: allow up to 50% of unused paid burst credits to rollover one time into the next calendar month only (no multi-month stacking).
2) Accounting: amortize the rollover credit across the next two invoices (so revenue recognition isn't materially impacted this quarter).

If Lumina chooses the prepaid topup we should reduce the administrative risk (no provisional billing). For on-demand auto-topup we must add an explicit PO/acceptance flow that authorizes immediate charges and identifies the billing owner email/address.

If this looks good I can send a DocuSign with PO-ready language and schedule the capacity change for May 26 (24 hours before the window).
